/bin/bash -lc "set -eu
printf '%s\\n' '--- observed close head ---'
git show -s --format='%H%n%P%n%s' HEAD
printf '%s\\n' '--- expected spine ---'
git show -s --format='%H%n%P%n%s' e3eb7b09817c0315cd2282308db00d95a0fa7a66
printf '%s\\n' '--- relation ---'
git merge-base --is-ancestor e3eb7b09817c0315cd2282308db00d95a0fa7a66 HEAD; printf 'expected_is_ancestor_rc=%s\\n' \""'$?"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- declared_row_id references ---'
rg -n \"declared_row_id|row_coverage|refused_rows|diff_nonempty\" . --glob '"'!*.pyc'"' --glob '"'!.git/**'"' | head -160
printf '%s\\n' '--- receipt artifacts ---'
find docs/receipts -maxdepth 3 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort | head -160
printf '%s\\n' '--- receipt commits and exact diff paths ---'
for spec in \\
  'SR a49ef69bf23fe5b216617a79c46f02dba68e91b6 31359587cfe388153831665b20b17dc3aa10ec4b' \\
  'GK 1f93dd89ecaa861d6b6d63f8ef2c0b1041a98c26 c04e8ef5aac9201ceb00d6be48ccb7577dcaad12' \\
  'PG a1e26019abce26ab88bda4bf468f3bb59dfaeab4 6c2859701486f8b7fcbd99e6661ef36ce21b58a9' \\
  'PG f9b7190d8da57fdc6fcdcfa173bf8fad77c3174e 2e8773cf823e487da8c7691a76b5d0ca522c8053' \\
  'PE 6c2859701486f8b7fcbd99e6661ef36ce21b58a9 1f93dd89ecaa861d6b6d63f8ef2c0b1041a98c26'
do
  set -- "'$spec
  task=$1 base=$2 merge=$3
  printf '"'%s %s..%s\\n' \""'$task" "$base" "$merge"
  printf '"'base_type=%s merge_type=%s parents=' \""'$(git cat-file -t "$base")" "$(git cat-file -t "$merge")"
  git show -s --format='"'%P' \""'$merge"
  git diff --name-status "$base" "$merge"
done
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- main checkout ---'
git -C /home/trey-agent/Code/delegate-agent status --short --branch
git -C /home/trey-agent/Code/delegate-agent rev-parse HEAD
git -C /home/trey-agent/Code/delegate-agent branch --show-current
"
